interpretation: CAD support proxy equality did not survive slicing. Front/rear narrow support overlap nearly disappears in the nominal bead model. This is projected overlap across a 0.06mm gap, not actual contact area or measured support strength.
decision: Keep existing integration manifest unchanged; wide-end relief is a rejected adoption candidate pending support redesign.
next_design_constraint: Preserve printable front/rear support width and vertical section while accommodating maximum battery plus explicit fit allowance; revise ledge/seat geometry or overall size if needed rather than interpreting CAD support alone as sufficient.
